'''Dereth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Feline/Legends|felinoid]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]].<ref name="GFT" /> He was a [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] and [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]]<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> who was partnered with [[Jabot]].<ref name="GFT" /> Together, the pair had won a fortune cheating at [[Helcos]] and [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tournaments.<ref name="EGWT" /> They used an [[implant communicator]] to cheat at Helcos and beat the [[Borlorian]] [[Merex]].<ref name="GFT" />
